plan: Sell SOXL and SPAL to zero to eliminate all leveraged ETF exposure.
Trim SPY to 20% to reduce concentration and meet the mandate.
Trim SMH and QQQI to reduce exposure to flagged holdings.
Buy SNOW at 5% to add a top-quality long setup.
This plan prioritizes capital preservation and reduces overall risk.
conservative.read: This conservative plan targets around 1.5% per month, focusing on capital preservation. It significantly reduces risk by eliminating leveraged ETFs and lowering concentration. Expect lower volatility and drawdowns, but also more modest returns.

plan: Trim SOXL and SPAL to maintain minimal leveraged ETF exposure.
Trim SPY to 25% to reduce concentration and meet the mandate.
Trim SMH and QQQI to reduce exposure to flagged holdings.
Buy SNOW at 4% to add a top-quality long setup.
This plan balances risk and growth, reducing overall concentration.
balanced.read: This balanced plan targets around 2.5% per month, focusing on risk-first growth. It reduces leverage and concentration while blending broad index and quality tech. Expect moderate volatility and drawdowns, with a focus on sustainable growth.

plan: Add to SOXL and SPAL to increase leveraged ETF exposure, staying within mandate.
Trim SPY to 25% to reduce concentration and meet the mandate.
Trim QQQI to reduce exposure to a flagged holding.
Buy SNOW at 6% to add a top-quality long setup.
Add to CRWD to press a working position.
This plan leans into leverage and high-scoring setups for aggressive growth.
aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets around 4% per month, aiming for stretched growth. It utilizes and adds to leveraged ETFs and concentrates in high-scoring setups. Be aware this significantly raises both upside potential and drawdown risk, and leveraged ETFs experience daily decay.

plan: Sell SOXL and SPAL to zero to eliminate all leveraged ETF exposure.
Add to QQQI to 30% to increase income exposure.
Trim SPY to 20% to reduce concentration and meet the mandate.
Sell SMH and trim CRWD to reduce high-beta single name exposure.
This plan prioritizes steady monthly distributions and low drawdown.
income.read: This income plan targets around 1% per month, focusing on parking cash for yield. It rotates into income ETFs and broad index, cutting leverage and high-beta names. Prioritizes low drawdown and reliable income, but distributions are variable and NAV can still fall.
